FamiStudio sound engine from tag 4.5.1, commit d05a7549da6aad6faf16cf2736cc39a2cbd8f64f.
https://github.com/BleuBleu/FamiStudio/tree/4.5.1/SoundEngine

The source header identifies engine version 4.5.0; the 4.5.1 release retains that engine.
The vendored source and NTSC note tables are unmodified. Generated assembly aliases
its RAM declarations into compiler-managed storage and embeds the note tables.
See LICENSE and the permissive notice at the top of the assembly source.
